data.ruling:
The refutation holds. The re-rank drops SN74LVC1G14DCKR for failing sourcing rule 5 because "no alternate that passes rules 1 to 4 is named". Rule 5 passes when a pin-compatible alternate exists that passes rules 1 to 4 and works in the same circuit. Not having named one is not a failure of the part. The Nexperia 74LVC1G14GW,125 (LCSC C265125) is such an alternate.
- It passes rule 1: it has an LCSC number and JLCPCB places it.
- It passes rule 2: Nexperia is on the S1 list.
- It passes rule 3: it is in the jlcparts copy of 2026-09-14.
- It passes rule 4: JLCPCB stock is far above the gate of 50 for a need of 5 (5 boards x 1).
- Its pins match the DCK package (SC70-5) pin for pin, it has the same function, and no firmware is involved.
- It meets all four requirement values P2 set for this function: I_off on the input, positive-going threshold (VT+) below 3.15 V at 3.3 V, a supply of 3.201 to 3.399 V, and 0 to 50 degC ambient.
- Its datasheet also states unlimited input rise and fall times, so the input transition-rate limit that removed the 74LVC1G04 does not apply.
The function has two ranked parts, so the dropped part could take rank 3 with this alternate carrying rule 5. The re-rank allowed the same route for SN74LVC1G175DCKR through 74LVC1G175GW,125. The facts behind the drop are correct: the Texas Instruments Digi-Key rows read 0 and the only stocked row is UMW (4), which is not on S1. Scope is function, not part: what holds is the drop reason within this function, checked against this function's requirement values. Nothing about the part itself fails, so SN74LVC1G14DCKR fails no other function.

- Datasheet, Nexperia 74LVC1G14 Rev. 19.1 (3 September 2024), read 2026-10-02T00:10:53Z:

  - Section 7.1 and Table 3: pin 1 n.c., 2 A, 3 GND, 4 Y, 5 VCC.
  - Table 6: VCC 1.65 to 5.5 V; Tamb -40 to +125 degC.
  - Table 7: IOFF +/-2 uA max at -40 to 85 degC and at -40 to 125 degC (VI or VO = 5.5 V, VCC = 0 V).
  - Table 8: VT+ 1.71 V max at VCC 3.0 V and 2.36 V max at 4.5 V. Both are below 3.15 V.
  - Section 2: "Unlimited rise and fall times".
- Nexperia product page, read 2026-10-02T00:11:23Z: productState "production" in the page body. This is recorded only; it is not part of rules 1 to 4.

- Digi-Key, read 2026-10-02T00:11:11Z: the Texas Instruments row reads stock_available 0 (Active, lead time 20 weeks). The UMW row reads 4, and UMW is not on S1.
- JLCPCB C35740, read 2026-10-02T00:10:44Z: stockCount 193328, canPresaleNumber 192279.
